Hero.heading: Stanislav Muntyan
Hero.intro: Passionate about full-stack web development, I specialize in the MERN stack and scalable architecture. From designing interactive frontends with React to structuring robust RESTful APIs with Node.js, I love bringing digital products to life. A dedicated self-learner with an eye for quality, reinforced by my background in QA and testing.

qa.title: QA Tester
qa.description: Rapidly evolved from manual testing to engineering automated solutions. Built E2E test suites with Cypress and simulated heavy traffic with JMeter.

Education.title: Education
Education.description: Technical training focused on building scalable applications across different platforms. Gaining experience with Java, SQL, and enterprise-grade development practices.

contactManager.title: Full Stack Contact Manager
contactManager.description: A secure full-stack application for managing personal contacts. Features a robust RESTful API, persistent data storage, and efficient asynchronous server communication.

blogApp.title: Blog App
blogApp.description: A scalable blogging platform featuring global state management and dynamic routing. Implements secure user authentication (JWT) and responsive UI design.
